title: Delivery pipeline loop gates
description: Fail-closed gates wiring the ticket-delivery conveyor into the GSD loop: a blocking plan:post gate runs the ticket-graph validator (Gate 2), so a decomposition without materialized, valid PLAN files cannot pass planning.

delivery_pipeline.graph_gate.description: Run the delivery-pipeline ticket-graph validator as a blocking plan:post gate (mechanical Gate 2).

delivery_pipeline.uat_gate.description: Block ship until the phase has verification evidence (fail-closed `phase uat-passed` predicate at ship:pre).
